# Fig Pro Audio

> Fig Pro Audio (Aldana Consulting LLC) makes audio plugins for Mac and Windows: FigAMP, a guitar amp simulator; FigGutEQ, an EQ made only for guitar; FigSTRIP, a channel strip for mixing; FigTECH EQ, a stereo tube program EQ; and FigVERB, a free reverb made for guitar (Mac). FigAMP, FigGutEQ, FigSTRIP and FigTECH EQ are one-time purchases with a free, fully featured 14-day trial, sold through Moonbase; FigVERB is free, activated with a free account. Formats: Audio Unit (Mac), VST3 (Mac and Windows) and a standalone app; FigTECH EQ adds CLAP. Requirements: macOS 11 or later (FigTECH EQ: macOS 12 or later) (Apple Silicon or Intel), or Windows 10/11 64-bit. No subscription, no dongle.

## Products

- [FigAMP](https://figproaudio.com/): guitar amp plugin. Eight touch-sensitive classic amp voices (Singer, Brit 45, Chime 30, Black Panel, Hot 20, Liquid 100, Cali V, Steel 50), each with a Classic Tone button and its own classic-style amp-head faceplate and knobs; Bass Mode and a clean Blend knob for bass guitar; input level control with VU meter; four studio console preamps (Brit 73, NY 312, Brit 4K, London A); compressor pedal; six matched guitar cabinets and two bass cabinets (4x10, 1x15) plus your own impulse responses; tempo-synced delay; room reverb; Stereo Shift doubler; noise gate; Stereo/Mono switch; 34 factory presets (including a bass preset for every amp) and your own presets. Version 1.4.0. Price: $49 (MSRP $99). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figamp. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figamp.
- [FigGutEQ](https://figproaudio.com/figguteq.html): the guitar-only EQ, built to sit next to FigAMP. Eight bands named for where a guitar lives (Low Cut, Bottom, Mud, Mids, Bite, Presence, Air, High Cut) with frequency and note readouts; Pick Attack (boost or cut only on the pick transient); Tuning Lock (marks open strings and moves the low end with the tuning, Standard E down to 8-string F#); real-time In/Out analyzer; zero latency with optional 2x/4x oversampling; STEREO/MONO switch with L/R meters; 18 presets, each in a PRE AMP and a POST AMP version. Version 1.0.0. Price: $29 launch price (MSRP $49). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figguteq. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figguteq.
- [FigSTRIP](https://figproaudio.com/figstrip.html): channel strip plugin. Six sections in any order: Preamp (stepped or continuous gain, level-matched Drive, transformer), Filters (18 dB/oct high-pass, 12 dB/oct low-pass, can feed the sidechain), Dynamics (compressor with RMS/peak detection, auto release and auto make-up, plus gate/expander, external sidechain), Color EQ (broad stepped bands with a Fine mode), G EQ (four parametric bands) and Tape (drive, saturation, Warmth, output transformer, clip at -0.3 dBFS). Output with fader, pan, polarity, Mix and Auto Gain. Channel and Bus modes; Bus mode adds a glue compressor for mix buses and groups. 2x/4x oversampling or Zero Latency mode; mono, stereo and mono-to-stereo; undo/redo, A/B, 32 factory presets and your own presets in folders. Version 1.0.2. Price: $49 launch price (MSRP $99). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figstrip. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figstrip.
- [FigTECH EQ](https://figproaudio.com/figtecheq.html): stereo tube program equalizer inspired by classic 1960s passive tube program EQs. A passive network modelled part by part, a tube makeup stage and input and output transformers. Low band: CPS 20/30/60/100 Hz with LOW BOOST (up to +14 dB) and LOW ATTEN (up to -19 dB), usable together for the low-end boost-and-cut trick. High band: KCS 3/4/5/8/10/12/16 kHz bell boost up to +17 dB with BANDWIDTH, plus a separate HIGH ATTEN shelf at 5/10/20 kHz. OUTPUT, EQ IN/OUT, POWER true bypass and VU meters. Two units racked as a pair: Link, Dual (L/R) or Mid-Side, with copy between units. Analog panel: response display, INPUT, level-compensated DRIVE, MIX, WIDTH, analog pair variance, tube hum and noise (50/60 Hz), Off/2x/4x/8x oversampling with minimum or linear phase and a separate offline render setting. 15 factory presets, A/B, copy and paste. Audio Unit, VST3, CLAP and standalone; macOS 12 or later (Apple Silicon or Intel) or Windows 10/11 64-bit. Version 1.0.0. Price: $79 introductory price (MSRP $129). Buy: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/buy/figtecheq. Trial: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figtecheq.
- [FigVERB](https://figproaudio.com/figverb.html): free reverb plugin made for guitar, Mac only (Audio Unit and VST3, macOS 11 or later, Apple Silicon or Intel). Five modes, each its own reverb: Hall, Plate, Room, Chamber and Ambience. Controls: Mode, Decay (0.2 to 20 s, scaled per mode, with the real seconds on the LED readout), Pre-Delay (0 to 250 ms), Size, Tone, Low Cut on the reverb only (20 to 500 Hz), Mod, Duck, Mix (equal power), Output and Bypass. Click-free mode switching, zero latency, mono or stereo in, 44.1 to 192 kHz. 13 guitar presets and your own presets. Version 1.0.0. Price: free; activate with a free Fig Pro Audio account (no trial, no time limit). Download: https://aldana-consulting-llc.moonbase.sh/download/figverb.

## Pages

- [Why FigAMP](https://figproaudio.com/why.html): how FigAMP compares with all-in-one suites, signature packs and free capture players.
- [Guides](https://figproaudio.com/guides/): a getting-started guide for each plugin (FigAMP, FigGutEQ, FigSTRIP, FigTECH EQ, FigVERB), plus how-to guides for recording a clean DI guitar signal, dialling an amp sim for the mix, and blending bass DI with amp tone.
- [Support](https://figproaudio.com/support.html): installing, activating and common questions for every plugin. Email support@figproaudio.com.
- [Privacy](https://figproaudio.com/privacy.html) and [Terms](https://figproaudio.com/terms.html).

## Licensing

Buy once, activate on your own computers by signing in with your Fig Pro Audio (Moonbase) account inside the plugin. The trial is fully featured for 14 days; afterwards the plugin passes audio through unprocessed until activated (FigTECH EQ instead keeps working but drops out for two seconds every 45 seconds). FigVERB is free: activate it once with a free account, with no trial and no time limit.
